items.title: Millionaire Teens
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These teens are the real deal. Riches, fame, large moustaches and style! 10 luxurious skins to choose from. Live large in this millionaire lifestyle pack!

items.title: MarsCraft
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Have you ever wanted to visit Mars? Now you can! MarsCraft was created from real NASA satellite photos and height data. When you explore the surface of Mars in Minecraft, it will be the same as the real Mars!
+Free skins
+Detailed views of Olympus Mons- the largest mountain in the solar system!
+Every landing/crash site
+Aliens
+Hidden secrets & traps!
+Custom models

items.title: Pro Racers
items.creator: House of How
items.description: The need for speed is real in this pack! 8 pro racer skins ready to cruise the city and drive for the gold. Grab your pack fast before you are left in the dust!

items.title: Quantum Robots
items.creator: House of How
items.description: These robots seem to have been created in an alternate dimension. Colorful and neon, fiber optic designs will transport your and your friends into another reality. 15 unique designs to choose from!

items.title: Fall Sports 2021
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Let the Fall games begin! What sport will you choose this season? Hockey, soccer, cross country, cheerleader, and football. With this pack, of 10 athletic skins, you can play them all!

items.title: Fall Friends
items.creator: House of How
items.description: What do you have going on this fall? Getting married? Going back to school? Starting football, soccer or cheerleading? This pack was made for you! Fall fashion, weddings, sports and Halloween themes. Celebrate the changing of seasons and pick your favorite out the 14 autumnal-themed skins in this pack.

items.title: October Skins 2021
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Spooks, crows, curses, and frogs, it must be October! Live you best witch life, or even your best nine black cat lives with this pack. 14 specially crafted October-themed skins to trick or treat and haunt your friends. Download and have fun!

items.title: September Skins 2021
items.creator: House of How
items.description: The season of football and witches is here! This creatively crafted September-themed pack has skins for a variety of fall occasions. Check out the equinox king, autumn ninja, fall skeleton, a fashionable Libra and more! 14 skins for you to choose from.

items.title: Dungeon Crawler
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Dungeon Crawler puts your navigation and fighting skills to the test! Survive your way through a challenging maze of dangerous monsters, secrets, and hidden traps. 

- Combat
- Parkour
- Difficult
- 5 unique player skins

items.title: Axolotl Style
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
New update? Awesome! Along with the new update comes this pack with a new style! Wear these skins and live the new fashion of the axolotls!

+ 12 axolotl-loving skins
+ By Colibri Studios

items.title: Sci-Fi Lucky Block
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Have you ever wondered how life would be on a futuristic island? Hold on tight! We'll take you on an adventure to a lucky block island!
Enjoy this experience as you have many upgrades, loots, and maybe even some traps!

+ 2 free skins
+ By Withercore

items.title: Millionaire Modern Mansion
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
Millionaire Modern Mansion is a mansion with everything a millionaire needs! From fun rooms to a beautiful pool, this mansion has tons of stuff for you to share with your friends! Explore your mansion and enjoy all the luxury it has to offer.

+ Mega mansion
+ Modern design
+ Great with friends!
+ Personal yacht

items.title: Autumn Teens
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Leaves are falling all around. Autumn is here in all its beauty and color. Orange and brown cover the city streets.

+ 12 colorful teens
+ Perfect for the fall season
+ Skins for roleplay

items.title: Power Armor HD
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Feel free to pick up these super cool armor skins! Travel through the galaxy in style or hang out with your space friends wearing any of these colorful skins! This armor won't make you stronger, but will make you more stylish in any city in the galaxy!

+ Modern designs
+ 2 free skins!
+ 20 total skins

items.title: Crimson Boss
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Crimson. The color of flames and blood. The symbol of power and unyielding strength. Beware of the lair stained in red for the Crimson Boss will be near.

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Final boss attire inspired by the color of crimson!

items.title: Secret Underground Base
items.creator: Podcrash
items.description:
Underneath this seemingly regular modern house resides an extensive underground base full of hidden secrets! If you're looking for a survival spawn with unique furniture, a mysterious secret underground base, and beautiful interior design, this map is perfect for you!

- Includes 8 furniture models that can be crafted and placed around the map!

items.title: Ninja Mobs: Nether
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Become a mob ninja and hide from your friends! Blend in with the Nether and make it your domain!

- 8 Nether mob skins!

This skin set includes:

- Ghast
- Piglin
- Zombified Piglin
- Magma Cube
- Wither Skeleton
- Skeleton
- Blaze
- Enderman

items.title: Horned Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs have brand new neon horns! Just when you thought Creepers couldn't get any scarier...

- 8 skins!

This set includes the following designs:

- Creeper
- Enderman
- Skeleton
- Slime
- Ghast
- Zombie
- Pig
- Spider

items.title: Wolfhound - Medieval Textures
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Immerse yourself in a lushly painted world full of detail, precision and quality. Wolfhound breathes new life into your worlds with intricate and imaginative textures that will allow you to build beautiful structures like you never have before.

* Enhanced 64x64 textures
* One of the most popular Java packs
* Years of fine tuning
* Realistic design

items.title: Copper Creatures
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description:
Copper is the perfect element to create life with; well, in this universe anyway. Copper conducts electricity and is easily shaped making it perfect for production. Everyone around here has a creature as their butler. Just make sure you stay away from the feral ones though because they can be quite dangerous.
-By Dig Down Studios

items.title: Animals
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Friendly animals, just for everyone to brighten their day. Fluffy and cute, ready to share love and calmness with everyone who is in need.

+ Anime
+ Fashion
+ 2 free skins
+ By In Mine

items.title: Sirenhead: Scary Monsters
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Scary sirenhead monsters are ready to hunt other players. Would you choose to play as horror or as a survivor? Several different sirenhead monsters and survivors are here to bring you joy!

+ Monsters
+ Scary
+ Horrors
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Pop It
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Teens in antistress pajamas and outfits! Just for you to relax and enjoy your beloved game. Choose your favorite teen and pajama and join the game with friends.

+ Stress out
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Jungle Resort
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Imagine living in a luxurious mansion located in the thick of the tropics! The mansion has everything for a carefree life: beautiful furniture, a swimming pool and even a system of rivers where you can ride a jet ski with friends!

+ Luxury
+ 21 furniture models
+ 5 multi-colored jet skis
+ 2 bonus skins
+ By In Mine
